Method of Attack: Injected obfuscated JavaScript payload encoded in base64 to skim customer payment card details and billing information at checkout
Skimming script captured email, customer name, billing and shipping address, phone number, and card details (number, expiration date, CVV)
Discoverer: Mounir Hahad, head of Juniper Threat Labs at Juniper Networks
Attack Vector: Compromised website JavaScript file modified to inject malicious skimming script
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious domain zdsassets.com mimicking legitimate zdassets.com
Command and control domain resolved 905 times since creation
